'''Mak'o Rad''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] counter-intelligence [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was featured on the [[Painting/Legends|painting]] [[Imperial Agent (painting)|''Imperial Agent'']].<ref name="SWG:IA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The painting ''Imperial Agent'' featuring Mak'o Rad appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> ''Imperial Agent'' was one of three paintings that could be gained after the launch of "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," released on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
